snippet.title: What is Trailmakers? | Vehicle-Building Game
snippet.description:
Trailmakers is a vehicle building game based on real physics where creativity, highspeed action and controlled chaos all come together. Build whatever your heart desires using the intuitive building system with access to more than 300 different blocks that affect aerodynamics, speed, combat, and much more.

Getting started is simple. To build a car, all you need is four wheels, two hinges, a seat and an engine and you're good to go! The building system is made to be accessible for beginners, while still offering plenty of depth for experienced engineers as well. Airplanes, Mechs, Spaceships, Tanks, Dragons... The limit is your imagination!
